verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only external-agent integrations: an MCP server, an agents skill toolkit for Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, and a local API that outside AI assistants can call. None of these is a built-in AI assistant inside Anytype that users can delegate tasks to. The chat features are user-to-user messaging, and the GitHub "Agents" mention refers to extensibility, not an in-app assistant.
